span.description: Character offsets into the NORMALISED text of `file` (see normalize/SPEC.md). `end` exclusive. V3 'citation locates' = quote is contained in text[start:end].

file.description: Repo-relative path, e.g. corpus/documents/customers/.../01_x.md or corpus/triggers/TR-01-.../x.txt

section_label.description: Display label as it appears in the document (e.g. '§3.2 Automatic Renewal Terms'). Advisory; offsets are authoritative.

quote.description: Verbatim quote. Required on surfaced citations (V2); optional elsewhere.

stack_id.description: Clustered docs: '<area>/<cluster folder>'. Standalone docs: document path relative to corpus/documents/ without '.md'.

finding_type.description: Exactly ONE value per finding. When several apply, choose the first in this precedence order (the enum order): deadline_bound_right > deadline_bound_obligation > liability_or_compliance_exposure > recovery_opportunity > billing_discrepancy > cost_exposure > consistency_gap > clerical_update > watch. recovery_opportunity = a contractual or statutory right to recover (refund claim, pass-through, MFN refund). billing_discrepancy = a counterparty is charging outside its contract or on an expired/incorrect basis (e.g. a surcharge whose authority lapsed). 'Needs review' is never a finding_type; it is StackFinding.determination.

response_type.description: seek_refund_or_credit covers refund filings (e.g. CBP CAPE), invoice disputes and credit requests, and unwinding a surcharge already passed through. renegotiate includes change-order and equitable-adjustment requests. The system emits exactly one value; answer keys may accept up to two.
